label: Zimmo Scraper
title: Zimmo Scraper: Belgian Listings, EPC Scores & Prices
metaDescription: Scrape Belgian property listings from zimmo.be: price, EPC, flood data, planning info, contacts and photos. Paste any zimmo.be search URL.
intro: Paste any zimmo.be search link and get each Belgian listing's price, EPC energy score, flooding data, planning information, contacts and photos as structured data.
useCases: Compare asking prices across Belgian municipalities
Screen listings by EPC score and flood risk
Track new listings in a search every day

faq.a: No public one. This actor works as a Zimmo API: paste a zimmo.be search link (Dutch or French) and get every listing as JSON, CSV or Excel.

faq.q: How do I scrape zimmo.be without code?
faq.a: Search on zimmo.be with your filters, copy the link from the address bar (it looks like zimmo.be/nl/zoeken/?search=…), paste it and press Start.

faq.q: What Belgian property data do I get?
faq.a: Price, type and status, address, living and plot area, EPC label and score, heating, flood and planning information, the agency and the photos.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Zimmo API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Zimmo has no public API for its listings. This actor reads any public zimmo.be search, including the EPC, flood and planning data shown on each listing.
